lines: pursuant to Alabama Code 517-13-18, the Alabama Democratic Party hereby certifies the
names attached as nominees to appear on the November 3, 2026 Alabama General Election
This Certification amends the document filed July 1, 2026. The attached list includes changes
based on the August II Special Primary results and candidate withdrawals.
This certificate is subject to such disqualifications or corrective action as hereafter may be
Given under my hand, this twenty-fourth day of August, 2026.
Paid for by the Alabama Democratic Party I P.O. Box 950 | Montgomery, AL 36101
